title: 恶之花
original_title: Les Fleurs du mal（The Flowers of Evil）
year_display: 1857年出版（Britannica：Les Fleurs du mal (1857; The Flowers of Evil)）
background: Britannica（B309）：'perhaps the most important and influential poetry collection published in Europe in the 19th century'（19世纪欧洲最重要、最具影响力的诗集——B309）；'the fullest expression of French Romantic poetry'（B309）。
审查（B309）：'In 1857, authorities charged thirteen poems from this collection with offenses against religion and public morality'——'six poems were censored due to obscenity, leading to a fine'。
结构（B309）：'The collection consists of poems arranged into six sections'；波德莱尔坚持它不是'simple album'而是有'beginning and an end'。
outline: 六部分：忧郁与理想/巴黎即景/酒/恶之花/叛逆/死亡（篇目通说待核）。

influence.text: Britannica：'perhaps the most important and influential poetry collection published in Europe in the 19th century'（B309）。
Britannica：象征主义领袖'regarded themselves as his followers'（B309）。

editions: 《恶之花》（人民文学出版社/上海译文出版社版本，通说待核）。
reading.order: 象征主义源头（先本作后兰波）。
